name: Taima no Hibiki
source:
Hibiki Ohmae graduated from the College of Exorcism Trainers and is now a fledgling exorcist.

His first duty is to save people from sexual possession.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ150392.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
大前响从退魔师养成专科学校毕业，成为了一名初出茅庐的退魔师。

他的第一项任务，便是拯救被淫魔附身的人们。

[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ150392.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
